title: Event envelope (CloudEvents 1.0, binary mode)
description: The headers of one event message, as a map of lowercase header name to string value (be-protocol P12). NATS and Kafka carry them as message headers; the PostgreSQL queue stores them in be_bus.message.headers. Dead-letter messages add the be-dlq-* headers.

ce-id.description: UUIDv7, = besdk_outbox.id = the broker message ID.

ce-source.description: The producing component's or member's ID.

ce-dataschema.description: <component ID>@<version>/contracts/events/<file>#<subject>; a reference, not a URL to fetch.

ce-causationid.description: The handled event's ce-id; absent when the event came from a request.

ce-hopcount.description: Decimal integer; above 10 the message is dead-lettered.

ce-legalentity.description: Required on events about a transaction document.

ce-sequence.description: Reserved for sequence mode; not set in 1.0.

Nats-Msg-Id.description: On NATS: equal to ce-id on an event; dlq:<durable>:<stream sequence> on a dead-letter message (P12.7).

subject.description: <domain>.<name>.<event...>.v<n>, at least four segments, each [a-z][a-z0-9]*(_[a-z0-9]+)* (P12.3); a dead-letter message keeps the original subject in ce-type and travels on dlq.<durable>.<subject>.
